decision_policy.pass: all reviewers approve with evidence and no unresolved blocking issue
decision_policy.hold: review evidence is incomplete or a non-blocking question remains
decision_policy.fail: canon contradiction, broken branch logic, or critical production issue
decision_policy.canon_update: requires explicit human approval after PASS
